videos.video_subject: In 2012 a thirteen year old Kylian Mbappe was invited to Real Madrid's academy where Zinedine Zidane personally showed him around the club, but his family decided against the move and he joined Monaco instead, and Real Madrid finally signed him twelve years later on a free transfer in 2024
videos.video_script: At thirteen, Real Madrid flew him in and Zidane showed him around. His family said no. Twelve years later, they finally got him. For free. Which makes you wonder,
